defect_analysis.binding_mechanism: base.wrap() does obj._oleobj_.QueryInterface(klass.CLSID, IID_IDispatch) then klass(ole), where klass comes from gencache.GetModuleForTypelib - i.e. a makepy STATIC binding. IMathTransform.IInverse is emitted as InvokeTypes(10, LCID, 1, (9,0), ()) with wFlags=1 (DISPATCH_METHOD|PROPERTYGET semantics), which SolidWorks rejects as 'cannot read write-only property'.
defect_analysis.internal_inconsistency_found: Within the SAME function, IMultiply and ArrayData are reached through base.value(...) / wrapped accessors, but IInverse alone is invoked directly on the statically-bound object. The defect is a local inconsistency, not a systemic COM-layer flaw.
